correctness.rationale: At the Kirchhoff central vertex, the edgewise solution of Du''=su with absorbing leaves gives F(s)=[csch(z)+q csch(qz)]/[coth(z)+q coth(qz)], z=ell sqrt(s/D). The series at zero yields T0=ell^2(1+q^2)/(4D) and T'0=ell^4 q^2/(24D^2)>0. The renewal identity (1-F)/(rF) is standard. At z=log4, the exact q=4 ratio before dividing by (log4)^2 is 299421/37000; the strict rational logarithm bound proves benefit, while 19q^2-75q-26>0 covers every q>=5. As q grows, csch(qz) decays exponentially and the gain ratio is asymptotic to 15/[2(log4)^2 q]. The large-rate asymptotic shows eventual divergence, giving a positive global minimizer, not uniqueness. The independent rational q4 calculation and q=5,6,10,50,100 samples agree; samples are not the infinite proof.
